title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer / DevSecOps Lead
description: Senior DevSecOps Engineer / DevSecOps Lead | Experience: 10+ Years Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to lead and support DevOps, cloud infrastructure, automation, and security initiatives. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS, CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and security tools. The role focuses on integrating security into the development process and maintaining reliable, secure production environments. Key Responsibilities ● Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions. ● Integrate security testing such as SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and vulnerability scanning into pipelines. ● Build, manage, and secure AWS infrastructure, including IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, networking, logging, and monitoring. ● Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation; use Ansible where required. ● Manage Docker and Kubernetes environments and implement container and cluster security controls. ● Use scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate operational and security tasks. ● Monitor systems, investigate incidents, troubleshoot production issues, and coordinate vulnerability remediation. ● Apply Linux and Windows server hardening, patching, access controls, and security best practices. ● Troubleshoot networking and connectivity issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, routing, VPNs, and AWS networking. ● Support security audits and compliance requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CIS Benchmarks. ● Guide technical teams and work closely with development, infrastructure, networking, and security teams. Required Technical Skills ● Cloud: AWS (Azure knowledge is an advantage). ● CI/CD & Version Control: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Git, GitHub, GitLab. ● Infrastructure Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible. ● Containers: Docker, Kubernetes. ● Security Tools: SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, OWASP ZAP, Trivy, AWS Inspector, Checkov or tfsec. ● AWS Security: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, KMS, CloudTrail. ● Monitoring: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack or Splunk. ● Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN, VPC, subnets, Security Groups, and Network ACLs. ● Operating Systems & Scripting: Linux, Windows Server, Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Experience & Qualifications ● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. ● 10+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, information security, or DevSecOps. ● Strong hands-on experience securing AWS environments and managing enterprise CI/CD pipelines. ● Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, container security, and automation. ● Good understanding of networking and cloud connectivity troubleshooting. ● Experience supporting production environments, handling critical incidents, and leading technical initiatives. Preferred Certifications & Skills ● AWS Certified Security – Specialty or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional. ● Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS). ● HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Microsoft Azure DevOps Engineer Expert. ● Knowledge of Zero Trust, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, SIEM, SBOM, and software supply chain security Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹3,000,000.00 per year Benefits: Flexible schedule Work Location: In person
